speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Both Members have given notice of their intention to move their Motions on 6 February 2023.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: For benefit of the Members, let me just read out the terms of the Motions.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: This is because the two Motions cover common topics and related issues, albeit from different perspectives.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: It will also allow for more efficient conduct of Parliamentary business.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the day and Notices of Motion.
